positions.title: Senior Technology Assistant
positions.description:
-Provided technical support to students, faculty, and staff
-Led technical support for major educational meetings and on-campus conferences
-Installed new computers and accessories when necessary
-Troubleshot errors and technical issues as they arose
-Solved technical issues in person and over the phone

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
-Led tutoring sessions twice a week
-Assisted students one on one during in-class coding exercises
-Graded between 20-40 assignments biweekly
-Ran test cases and provided written feedback on computer science assignments written in C++

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description:
-Managed multi-line telephone
-Detail-oriented database entry
-Updated files and file organization for thousands of students
-Emphasized customer service

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
-Provided design consultation and technical support to interdisciplinary teams of undergraduate and graduate students
-Facilitated discussions between student teams and university officials around budget and timelines
-Collaborated with fellow programmers and student teams to outsource pieces of products to meet a yearlong deadline

company.name: Berglund Creative Design Team -- Pacific University

volunteerExperiences.description:
Positions Held: 
President & Conference Co-Chair(2018-2019)
Vice President (2017-2018)
Treasurer (2016-2017)
Member (2015-2016)

Planned activities and discussion for bi-weekly meetings. Coordinated teams and transportation for yearly programming contest. Coordinated club merchandise and fundraising. Designed annual budget and manage club finances. Assisted in coordinating biennial CS conference and communicating with local students and schools.

Mission: Women In Computer Science is dedicated to fostering a community which promotes equal opportunities for women in computer science by helping to create professional development opportunities and advocating for more women to enter and contribute to this dynamic field.

Open to all genders.
ACM-W affiliated.

Educated 1st and 2nd graders on code and critical thinking through the use of online games, activities and hands-on experience. Collaborated with the teacher to provide activities for one hour a week.
